worldcombat.skill.lick.summary: Snap a tongue far past ordinary melee range at the target: the hit is light, but it comes out very fast and is likely to leave the target numb. The coil form can also drag them a step closer.
worldcombat.skill.lick.description.0: A landed lick deals about %1$s contact damage.
worldcombat.skill.lick.description.1: The tongue reaches %1$s blocks from the mouth along the chosen direction with a %3$s block tip radius; a licked target has a %2$s%% chance to be paralysed. You may lash empty air, and a wall, cover or a front ally/foe blocks the tongue first.
worldcombat.skill.lick.description.2: There is a %1$s second gap between snapping out and landing; the coil form drags the target up to %2$s blocks closer (less if terrain blocks it).
worldcombat.skill.lick.use.0: Lick a target from beyond melee range
worldcombat.skill.lick.use.1: Top up paralysis on a foe that is not numb yet
worldcombat.skill.lick.use.2: Drag a licked target a step closer
worldcombat.skill.lick.preference.coil.h: On: a landed lick drags the target closer and slightly raises the numb chance, but the wind-up is 3 ticks longer and recovery and cooldown are longer. Off: the quick lick comes out faster and cheaper, leaving only damage and the numb chance.
worldcombat.skill.lick.preference.ai.max: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of lashing. Larger values start the lick at the edge of its long reach.
worldcombat.skill.lick.preference.ai.ope: By default it favours a target that is not numb yet, saving paralysis for one that can still take it, but an already numb foe can still be licked as an ordinary light hit; "any time" treats them alike.
worldcombat.skill.lick.description.addit: Paralysis lasts 40 seconds: movement is halved and every attempt to act has a 25% chance to fail; Electric types and targets immune to paralysis cannot be paralysed.
